integrity: The theorem is analytic. The attached checker tests algebraic consequences and explicit Fourier-frame realizations but is not used as a substitute for the quantified proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to equiprobable pure-state unit-norm tight frames only; it does not settle the conditional-subentropy conjecture for nonuniform priors, mixed signal states, or general non-tight pure-state ensembles. The state-discrimination value d/n is known independently; the new content is the exact conditional-subentropy formula and conjecture implication.
title: Conditional subentropy conjecture for equiprobable pure-state tight frames
